subject: Pilot outcomes & short testimonial ask
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily@harmonix.ai>, Tom Garcia <t.garcia@retailcap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot outcomes & short testimonial ask

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for running the POC with our edge-serving configuration over the last 4 weeks. We pushed a small set of optimizations mid-pilot (dynamic batching + prefix caching) and saw the behavior you flagged improve significantly. Quick summary attached and pasted below — I kept it two bullets so you can share easily.

Key outcomes (pilot window: Apr 12 – May 12):
- Avg inference latency (95th pctl) decreased from ~420ms to ~120ms for 256-token requests after tuning; median token cost down 38%.
- End-to-end SLA for your inference path improved from 92.1% to 99.2% (measured as requests under 300ms for your typical 128-token prompts).
- Throughput headroom: system handled 3x your baseline burst for 30s without queue growth (no dropped requests).

We put the full slide deck and a short log digest in the attachments (redwood_poc_metrics_deck.pdf, redwood_log_digest.csv). If these numbers look right on your side, would you be open to a 10–15 line quote and a 15-minute call to record a very short testimonial? We usually ask for a single-sentence outcome and a one-line on business impact (e.g., "reduced latency by X and improved conversion by Y") — nothing heavy.

If you prefer, we can anonymize specifics and only use a company-level blurb. Happy to send a draft quote for you to edit.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Quick confirmation of metrics (reply is fine)
2) If yes, pick a 15-min slot next week for a short on-record call OR send a 2-line quote via email
3) We’ll prepare a 1-page case snapshot and share for approval before publishing

Thanks — appreciate you and the team for moving fast on this.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_poc_metrics_deck.pdf (pptx), redwood_log_digest.csv (csv)

From: Emily Park <emily@harmonix.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@retailcap.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot outcomes & short testimonial ask

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the clear summary and for the deck — that aligns with what we measured on our end after you tuned the batcher. A couple quick numbers from our telemetry:
- Checkout conversion for sessions hitting the new LLM path improved +4.2% (stat sig at p<0.05)
- Mean response time for the recommendation API fell from 380ms to 115ms (matches your numbers closely)

We're happy to provide a short quote. We prefer a line that keeps product names generic, e.g., "Using Redwood Inference, we reduced model latency by ~70% which materially improved conversion on personalized recommendations." Feel free to draft a 1–2 sentence blurb we can approve.

Also OK with a 15-minute call if you want to record a quick on-camera quote — Tom can join. He’s out Tuesday morning but free Wed/Thu afternoon next week.

Emily Park
Head of Applied ML, Harmonix AI
emily@harmonix.ai

Date: 2027-05-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Harmonix quick quote and publishing checklist

Marissa / Monica —

Emily confirmed the numbers and is open to a short quote + a 15-min call. Tom can join Wed/Thu afternoon next week. Emily suggested keeping product names generic in the quote.

Ask: can we get a one-page case snapshot ready and a short draft quote to send to them by Monday? I can draft the quote — two sentences max — but I’d like Marissa to lead the case write-up and own the approvals flow. Monica, can you prep the permission/legal checklist and the logo usage form (I attached a template in this thread earlier)?

Draft quote idea (please edit):
"Using Redwood Inference, we reduced model latency by ~70% for our recommendation API, which led to a +4.2% lift in checkout conversion — delivering measurable revenue impact."

If you’re good with the above, I’ll send the draft to Emily and Tom and propose two 15-min slots next Wed/Thu.

Thanks —
Logan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Emily / Tom —

Appreciate the quick signal — that draft looks great and we’ll keep it product-agnostic. Would either of these 15-minute windows work?
- Wed Jun 2, 2027 — 2:00pm PT
- Thu Jun 3, 2027 — 3:30pm PT

If neither works, feel free to propose times. We’ll record audio only and circulate the final short blurb for your approval before publishing.

Attached: case_one_prep.docx (one-pager draft), logo_permission_form.pdf — please sign / reply to confirm logo use (we’ll anonymize if needed).

Final draft quote we’ll send for sign-off: 
"Using Redwood Inference, we reduced model latency by ~70% for our recommendation API, resulting in a measurable +4.2% lift in checkout conversion."

Thanks — looking forward to the quick sync.

Best,
